items.title: Can Arista's Third Guidance Raise Still Make You Money?
items.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) trades near $188, about where it stood before its August report raised its 2026 revenue outlook for the third time. The easy read is that the market has yet to price that forecast. It already did, once. The market paid for that forecast in August and has since handed most of that payment back, leaving you a claim on the next raise.
